mapper.select: SELECT A.i_num, A.c_name FROM com_info A INNER JOIN com_ty B ON A.i_num = B.i_num AND B.ty = #{comTy} ORDER BY A.c_name ASC
SELECT brand_id ,brand_name FROM brand ORDER BY brand_name

SELECT * from( SELECT ( SELECT count(*) from prdct where brand_id=A.brand_id and prdct_stat_ty_cd='00100003' and prdct_visible_cd='00500001' and prdct_ty_cd=#{prdctTyCd} ) cnt ,brand_id ,brand_name FROM brand A ) B WHERE cnt>0;

SELECT * from( SELECT ( SELECT count(*) from prdct where brand_id=A.brand_id and prdct_stat_ty_cd='00100003' and prdct_visible_cd='00500001' and (prdct_ty_cd='00300003' or prdct_ty_cd='00300004' )) cnt ,brand_id ,brand_name FROM brand A ) B WHERE cnt>0;
mapper.update: UPDATE com_info SET c_type = #{cType}, c_name = #{cName}, e_name = #{eName}, p_num1 = #{pNum1}, p_num2 = #{pNum2}, c_memo = #{cMemo}, c_state = #{cState} WHERE i_num = #{iNum}
mapper.select: SELECT i_num ,c_type ,c_name ,e_name ,p_num1 ,p_num2 ,c_memo ,c_state FROM com_info WHERE i_num=#{iNum}
SELECT C.i_num ,C.c_name eName FROM com_info C, com_ty T WHERE C.i_num = T.i_num
SELECT C.i_num iNum ,C.c_name cName FROM com_info C, com_ty T WHERE C.i_num = T.i_num AND T.ty = #{comTy}
